full_details: In the morning the account book stayed shut over the tables. You did not open the three leaves, and you entered no new sum. At two you played in Richard the Third. Still in a duke's gown, you took the call from Somerset House. Three nights at Richmond: St Stephen's, St John's, and Innocents'. Navarre, the lovers, and something old to laugh at. Not the king. He said the book came out of Antwerp. He stood at the back of yesterday's house like a carter, and Burbage made him weep. Heneage's office is not filled. You will be paid slow. Nothing was paid. He wants clean hose, and he did not say whose heel. You did not choose the old play. The moon was up when you were home. The oriel across the way was dark.
one_sentence: You came off Richard the Third into Hunsdon's call, and you told Heminges at once who yesterday's justice was.
title: Heard three nights at Richmond
